note: 系列 A 例句軌 B2 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: The old bridge was built more than a hundred years ago.
items.zh: 這座老橋是在一百多年前建造的。

items.sentence: She has been studying English for almost three years.
items.zh: 她學英文已經快三年了。

items.sentence: By the time we arrived, the show had already started.
items.zh: 我們到的時候，表演已經開始了。

items.sentence: Although the weather was cold, we enjoyed the long walk.
items.zh: 雖然天氣很冷，我們還是很享受這段長長的散步。

items.sentence: The movie was very long. However, it was never boring.
items.zh: 這部電影很長，不過一點也不無聊。

items.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, the match continued as planned.
items.zh: 儘管下著大雨，比賽還是照計畫進行。

items.sentence: My sister loves spicy food, whereas I prefer sweet snacks.
items.zh: 我姊姊喜歡吃辣的食物，而我比較喜歡甜的點心。

items.sentence: If I had known earlier, I would have helped you.
items.zh: 如果我早點知道，我就會幫你了。

items.sentence: Many people believe that technology makes our lives easier.
items.zh: 很多人相信科技讓我們的生活更輕鬆。

items.sentence: The report must be finished before the meeting on Monday.
items.zh: 這份報告必須在星期一開會前完成。

items.sentence: He has been working hard to improve his grades.
items.zh: 他一直很努力想提升自己的成績。

items.sentence: We had never seen such a beautiful sunset before.
items.zh: 我們以前從來沒看過這麼美的夕陽。

items.sentence: Even though she was tired, she kept practicing the song.
items.zh: 雖然她很累，還是不停地練習那首歌。

items.sentence: Recycling helps protect the environment for future generations.
items.zh: 回收有助於為未來的世代保護環境。

items.sentence: The new phone is being repaired at the local shop.
items.zh: 那支新手機正在附近的店裡維修。

items.sentence: If I were you, I would apologize to your friend.
items.zh: 如果我是你，我會向你的朋友道歉。

items.sentence: Spending too much time online can affect your health.
items.zh: 花太多時間上網可能會影響你的健康。

items.sentence: The letters were delivered to the wrong address by mistake.
items.zh: 那些信件被誤送到了錯誤的地址。

items.sentence: She spoke so quietly that nobody could hear her clearly.
items.zh: 她說話太小聲，沒有人能聽清楚。

items.sentence: They have been living in that house since last summer.
items.zh: 他們從去年夏天起就一直住在那棟房子裡。

items.sentence: After he had saved enough money, he bought a bicycle.
items.zh: 他存夠了錢之後，就買了一輛腳踏車。

items.sentence: While some students prefer reading, others learn by listening.
items.zh: 有些學生偏好閱讀，有些則是透過聆聽來學習。

items.sentence: The problem could have been avoided with better planning.
items.zh: 只要有更好的規劃，這個問題原本是可以避免的。

items.sentence: Our teacher encouraged us to think before making decisions.
items.zh: 我們的老師鼓勵我們在做決定之前先思考。

items.sentence: Unless we leave now, we will miss the early train.
items.zh: 除非我們現在出發，不然就會錯過早班火車。

items.sentence: The museum, which opened last year, attracts many visitors.
items.zh: 這座去年開幕的博物館吸引了許多參觀者。

items.sentence: I wish I had spent more time with my grandparents.
items.zh: 我真希望以前能多花點時間陪我的祖父母。

items.sentence: Watching the news helps us understand world events better.
items.zh: 看新聞幫助我們更了解世界上發生的大事。

items.sentence: The bakery smells wonderful whenever fresh bread is being baked.
items.zh: 每當店裡正在烤新鮮麵包時，麵包店就飄出很棒的香味。

items.sentence: Reading every day has clearly improved my writing skills.
items.zh: 每天閱讀明顯提升了我的寫作能力。
